turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so I'll be brief: who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay, and did anyone speak to him first?
Thanks for coming in. I want to walk through the version history.
Walk me through what, exactly? You haven't told me what's in it, and I'm not agreeing to anything until I see it on a screen.
612 words in one edit at 11:52 PM, then 794 more at 11:58 PM.
I'm writing those times down. Procedure 4.2 says a parent is contacted before any mark is entered, and nobody called me. Owen found out from the gradebook on his phone, in the middle of class.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero withdrawn, a written apology, and written confirmation that nothing about this goes on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, nothing was agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on his record; that is not the fair outcome, which is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and it never came up.
What moved her: Nothing did; you gave exact times, but with no date and no way for her to check them, they were only numbers she wrote down.
What cost ground: You never answered who decided on the zero or owned that nobody called her first, so she kept the procedure ground and used it as cover.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your late-night times came close to that night, and that is why she got shorter and went straight to procedure, but it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Open with one sentence owning that the zero went in before you called her, then show the version history with its date and offer the 4.4 rewrite.
Redo the debrief as a table please.
